brief: Screening note on ethylene capacity in Southeast Asia: the capacity base, recent developments, and what we can’t confirm.

sections.title: Ethylene Capacity Base in Southeast Asia
questions: What is the current ethylene production capacity in Southeast Asia?
Which companies and plants make up the regional ethylene supply base?
What are the main process routes and statuses of these plants?
sections.tool_rationale: The plant register provides the list and details of ethylene plants in Southeast Asia, including company, process route, and status; documents may clarify or update plant status or capacity where relevant.
sections.unanswerable_if: If the register does not contain ethylene plants in Southeast Asia, or if all relevant capacity figures are withheld or not disclosed.

sections.title: Recent and Ongoing Capacity Developments
questions: What major ethylene capacity additions, expansions, or status changes have occurred in Southeast Asia in the past year?
Are there any announced projects, expansions, or debottleneckings affecting ethylene capacity?
Have there been any delays, cancellations, or significant operational events impacting capacity?
sections.tool_rationale: Documents provide details on recent expansions, startups, debottleneckings, and operational events; the register can confirm current status and filter for recent changes.
sections.unanswerable_if: If there are no documents or register entries describing recent or upcoming ethylene capacity changes in Southeast Asia.

sections.title: Gaps and Unconfirmed Capacity
questions: Are there any ethylene plants in Southeast Asia for which capacity is not publicly confirmed?
What are the main data gaps or uncertainties in the regional ethylene capacity base?
Are there any explicit limitations or caveats in the available sources?
sections.tool_rationale: The register flags plants with unconfirmed capacity; documents and corpus notes may highlight data gaps or source limitations; describe_corpus can summarize known limitations.
sections.unanswerable_if: If the register does not flag any unconfirmed capacities and documents do not mention any data gaps or limitations.

excluded.reason: The ASEAN Petrochemical Monitor explicitly states it does not publish aggregate regional capacity totals in its bulletins.
